english.title: Fail to give an inspector any assistance / information or provide facilities required regarding animal health
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable cause, you failed to give **(..SPECIFY NAME..), an inspector who was acting for the purpose of ensuring compliance with

(A)_[the EU TSE Regulation]_
(B)_[the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018]_

the

(C)_[assistance]_
(D)_[information]_
(E)_[facilities]_

that the inspector reasonably required
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(1)(d) of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018.
